provenance: LLM-authored synthetic technical discussions written specifically for this repository. No user messages, scraped corpora, personal data, or production telemetry. Not independently human-annotated.
label_policy: An observed malfunction takes precedence over a proposed capability; a proposed capability takes precedence over a request for guidance. Otherwise a request for guidance is question.
split_policy: Within each ordered class block of 30 scenario groups, index modulo 5 assigns 0,1,2 to train, 3 to validation, 4 to test. Assignment frozen before fitting. Four paraphrases always remain together. No corpus-derived vocabulary or IDF is fitted on validation/test.
